one_line: A learned brahmin mediator who divides the Buddha’s relics among eight claimant states in the middle Ganga plain.

appearance.age_look: Appears around 40, medium height, lean but sturdy build with the posture of a calm, disciplined scholar.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp nose, high cheekbones, warm medium-brown complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a small vertical tilak-style sandalwood paste mark on his forehead; default expression is composed and thoughtful, with soft but observant eyes.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, oiled and tied back in a low, tidy knot at the nape (not a high topknot), with a simple off-white cotton headband circling the head just above the ears.
appearance.costume: He wears a modest early–historic brahmin scholar’s outfit: an unstitched off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles in clean, straight pleats, a light saffron-beige upper cloth (uttariya) draped from the left shoulder across the torso and under the right arm, and a second narrow strip of cloth like a sacred thread (yajnopavita-style sash) of pale cream diagonally from left shoulder to right hip; his torso is fully covered by the layered drapes, and he has a simple knee-length, sleeveless light-brown cotton under-tunic visible at the neckline; feet in plain dark brown leather sandals; accessories are minimal—one small string of rudraksha-style wooden beads around the neck and a single narrow copper bangle on his right wrist.
appearance.signature: A lidded, rounded clay reliquary urn with a slightly pointed dome-shaped lid, about the size of his forearm, banded with simple incised geometric patterns and held carefully in both hands or cradled in the crook of one arm.

ref_desc: Dona is a medium-built, bearded brahmin in off-white ankle-length dhoti, saffron-beige draped upper cloth and cream diagonal sash over a light-brown under-tunic, with dark tied-back hair, headband, wooden beads, copper bangle and a banded clay reliquary urn in his hands.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Dona, a serious yet calm early–historic Indian brahmin mediator: a medium-built man of about forty with an oval, thoughtful face, medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, neat short beard and moustache, a small vertical sandalwood paste mark on his forehead, and dark brown-black hair tied back in a low knot with a simple off-white cotton headband. Show him in an off-white cotton dhoti wrapped in straight pleats down to his ankles, a saffron-beige upper cloth draped from his left shoulder across his chest and under his right arm so his torso is modestly covered, and a narrow cream sash worn diagonally from left shoulder to right hip over a visible light-brown sleeveless under-tunic at the neck and shoulders, with plain dark brown leather sandals on his feet. Add a simple string of wooden beads around his neck and a single narrow copper bangle on his right wrist. His signature prop is a rounded clay reliquary urn with a slightly pointed dome lid and simple incised bands, held carefully in both hands or cradled in one arm. Use a palette dominated by off-white, saffron beige, light brown, dark brown and touches of soft copper, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show his face, tied-back hair and consistent draped garments with the urn as the focal object.
